eval: window.S = (n, dt = 1/30) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) window.__engine.step(dt, { render: false }); window.__engine.redraw(); return n; }; window.U = async (pred, max = 3000, dt = 1/30) => { for (let i = 0; i < max; i++) { if (pred()) { window.__engine.redraw(); return i; } window.__engine.step(dt, { render: false }); if (i % 50 === 49) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0)); } window.__engine.redraw(); return -1; }; window.C = () => window.__game.combat; window.FAIL = (m) => { setTimeout(() => { throw new Error('[research.loop] ' + m); }); return 'FAIL ' + m; }; window.M = () => { const f = C().state().fight; return !!(f && f.needsInput && !f.busy && window.__game.ui.dialog.isChoosing); }; window.K = (code, frames = 2) => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code, key: code, bubbles: true })); S(frames); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code, key: code, bubbles: true })); S(2); return code; }; 'ok'

window.FG = async (group) => { for (let i = 0; i < 10 && C().system.sheet.pendingLevels > 0; i++) C().levelUp(null, null); if (window.__game.ui.dialog.isOpen && !C().state().fight) { window.__game.ui.dialog.close(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); S(3); } const f = C().foes().find((x) => x.group === group && x.alive && !x.hidden); if (!f) return 'none'; window.__game.teleport(f.x, f.z + 3); S(5); if (!C().state().fight) C().fight(group); if (!C().state().fight) return 'nofight'; C().auto(true); C().pace(10); const r = await U(() => !C().state().fight, 20000); S(20); if (r >= 0) return 'ok'; const fs = C().state().fight; window.STUCK = JSON.stringify({ group, round: fs && fs.round, current: fs && fs.current, needsInput: fs && fs.needsInput, busy: fs && fs.busy, picking: fs && fs.picking, list: fs && fs.combatants.map((c) => [c.id, c.state, c.hp, c.x, c.z]) }); return 'stuck'; }; window.EXP = async (n) => { const out = []; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { out.push(await FG('glade_goblins'), await FG('mire_goblins')); C().rest(); S(10); } return out.join(','); }; 'ok'

(() => { C().ledger(true, 'missions'); S(2); const R = C().system.research; let steps = 0; const log = []; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const cur = R.missions.current; if (!cur || cur.tasks.some((t) => t.type === 'report')) break; const t = cur.tasks.find((x) => !R.missions.done.has(R.missions.key(cur, x))); const idx = cur.tasks.indexOf(t); const box = document.querySelectorAll('.lu-ledger__mission.is-cur .lu-ledger__task')[idx]; if (!box) { FAIL('no task box for ' + t.id); break; } if (t.type === 'choice') { const ci = t.options.findIndex((o) => o.correct); const b = box.querySelectorAll('.lu-ledger__opt')[ci]; if (!b) { FAIL('no option buttons for ' + t.id + ': ' + box.textContent.slice(0, 80)); break; } b.click(); } else { const inp = box.querySelector('input'); if (!inp) { FAIL('no number input for ' + t.id + ': ' + box.textContent.slice(0, 80)); break; } inp.value = String(Math.round(R.missions.expected(t.target, R.dataset) * 1000) / 1000); box.querySelector('button').click(); } log.push(cur.id + '.' + t.id); steps++; } const cur2 = R.missions.current; return (cur2 && cur2.id === 'advise' && R.missions.unlocked('summaries') && R.missions.unlocked('interval')) ?
